assistant_json.message: Salam! Labas? Chnou houwa el machrou3 dialk lyoum (Crédit Auto, Immo, ou Conso)?
Mebrouk! Allah ysekhert. Chhal houwa el-montant li bghiti t-sellef l-had t-tomobile?
Wakha, 12 mlyoun. Bach nchouf wach t9der tkhless la traite, goul li chhal houwa el-salaire dialk el-net f ch-chher?
Mzyan, m3a 7500 DH dial salaire, n9drou n-proposiw lik crédit 3la 5 snin. Dossier dialk eligible!
Mchallah, l-Immo houwa ahsen mouchari3. Chhal taman dial had l-appartement?
Wakha a sidi, 600,000 DH. Chhal houwa el-salaire dialk net bach n-calculiw el-capacité d'emprunt?
Mzyan bzaf. M3a 1.5 mlyoun dial salaire, t9der tkhless la traite mzyan. N-bdaw l-ijraat?
